identity.description: 22P 0.5mm FPC/FFC rotary backlock; terminals 1..22 are vendor-numbered (No.1 at the reference pin mark), hold-downs are unnumbered by Omron — 23/24 is the land convention. Land = hydra's DS-nominal pads (0.25x1.1 at 0.5); the old CON22_1X22_DRB_XF2C_TYC bare-dir land (XF2C-labelled, 0.81mm pads) stays as legacy for boards that pin it.

relationships.evidence: Promotion supplied this footprint as a candidate; it is not qualified by a symbol-only draft.

entries.evidence: First-import fit pass: V1 re-author 2026-08-24 (xf2m.md): pin-sequential strip (B12/L22, Sige5 p21 idiom), captioned HOLD-DOWN gap, names hidden at symbol level (numbers are the connector identity), pitch 3.81, pin length 5.08, width from ink 15.24; rendered + LOOKed on a scratch sheet.
